text: The reliability change passes event data directly to openAttendeesWindow and captures onOk's attendee array. Accepting the dialog directly checks one case-insensitive existing attendee and preserves its DECLINED status and CHAIR role. It removes this scenario's calendar add/get, modification-time wait and full editor save. The actual helper and dialogaccept receiver support that narrower callback contract; the test no longer proves persistence in this task. No browser test or accessibility interaction ran.
title: The attendee duplicate test checks the dialog callback separately from calendar persistence
